description: This file defines models and a fetcher for comparing company facts from the SEC, including query parameters, data models, and data fetching logic.

classes.name: SecCompareCompanyFactsQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for SEC company facts comparison, including fact, year, fiscal period, and cache options.

classes.name: SecCompareCompanyFactsData
classes.description: Data model representing SEC company facts, with fields like cik, location, form, accession, fact, and unit.

classes.name: SecCompareCompanyFactsFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class to retrieve SEC company facts data, with methods to transform queries, extract data asynchronously, and transform data into models.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a SecCompareCompanyFactsQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw SEC data based on query parameters, calling external functions get_frame or get_concept.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw data into annotated results with validated SecCompareCompanyFactsData models.
